name: codex-optimizer
description: Silently rewrite supported shell commands with RTK, analyze output-compaction candidates without duplicate model context, and keep coding responses concise.

interface.shortDescription: Silent RTK rewrites and token-neutral output analysis.
interface.longDescription: A hook-backed Codex optimizer for coding tasks. It silently rewrites supported Bash commands through RTK, analyzes output-compaction candidates without adding duplicate model context, reports matching stages in the UI, and enables Caveman full and Ponytail full by default.
interface.defaultPrompt: Automatically apply Caveman full, Ponytail full, silent RTK command rewriting, and token-neutral output-stage analysis to this coding task.
